# Next Elite

> Next Elite (v2.3.0) is an open source, MIT-licensed, frontend-first Next.js 16.4 starter kit for SaaS apps, admin panels, ERPs and dashboards. It ships authentication with role-based access control (Better Auth), six-language type-safe i18n with RTL, 50+ accessible UI components (shadcn/ui on Radix UI and Tailwind CSS v4), and per-page JavaScript budgets enforced in CI. It has no bundled database: it is built to consume your existing REST, GraphQL or BFF API.

**Highlights**

- **API-first**: no database or ORM; connects to any REST, GraphQL or BFF backend.
- **Authentication & RBAC**: Better Auth email/password and Google sign-in, `admin` and `user` roles.
- **Type-safe i18n**: six languages with RTL; invalid translation keys fail the build.
- **50+ UI components**: shadcn/ui on Radix UI and Tailwind CSS v4, light and dark themes.
- **Performance budgets**: every page's initial JavaScript is measured with Brotli and capped in CI.
- **Production tooling**: Oxlint, Oxfmt, Knip, Vitest, Playwright, Lefthook, Commitlint, Sentry, Docker.
- **AI-agent ready**: `AGENTS.md` and the `project-standards` skill in `.agents/skills/`.

**Tech Stack** (exact versions from `package.json`)

- **Core**: Next.js 16.4.6 (App Router, Turbopack), React 19.3.1, TypeScript 7.0.2, Node.js 22.12+.
- **UI**: Tailwind CSS 4.3.5, shadcn/ui, Radix UI, CVA 0.7.1, Phosphor Icons 2.1.10, uPlot 1.6.32, Sonner 2.0.8.
- **Auth & data**: Better Auth 1.7.22, TanStack Query 5.107.1, TanStack Table 9.3.1, React Hook Form 7.92.0, Zod 4.6.7, T3 Env 0.13.11.
- **i18n**: next-intl 4.15.1 (English, Bengali, Arabic RTL, French, Spanish, Chinese).
- **Observability**: Sentry 11.12.0, Vercel Analytics 2.0.1.
- **Quality**: Oxlint 1.93.0, Oxfmt 0.78.0, Knip 6.45.1, Vitest 5.1.0, Playwright 1.65.0, Lefthook 2.2.2, Commitlint 21.2.4.

**Architecture**

- **Public pages** (`(public)`): Server Components for SEO, metadata, sitemap and Open Graph.
- **Auth pages** (`(auth)`): server shell with client forms; the Better Auth client loads only on submit.
- **Protected pages** (`(protected)`): client components; one `requireUser()` check in the layout picks the `@admin` or `@user` slot.
- **Permissions**: `useAuth().hasPermission()` for in-page checks; real data protection belongs in your API.
- **Data**: TanStack Query in the protected layout, fetching from your backend.
- **Locale**: stored in a cookie, no `/en` URL prefix.
- **Folders**: `src/app` routes, `src/features` auth, i18n and site logic, `src/components` UI, `src/libs` shared helpers, `messages` translations.

**Routes**

- `/` - home page
- `/ui-components` - live showcase of the UI components
- `/login`, `/register`, `/password-reset` - authentication
- `/dashboard`, `/analytics`, `/profile`, `/settings` - protected, with `@admin` and `@user` versions
- `/api/auth/*` - Better Auth; `/api/health` - health check
- `/sitemap.xml`, `/robots.txt`, `/manifest.webmanifest`, `/llms.txt` - SEO, PWA and AI discovery

**Commands**

- **Setup**: `git clone https://github.com/salmanshahriar/Next-Elite.git && cd Next-Elite && npm install && cp .env.example .env && npm run dev` (http://localhost:6767).
- **Check**: `npm run check` - typecheck, lint, Knip and unit tests.
- **Bundle size**: `npm run build && npm run size`; inspect with `npm run analyze`.
- **E2E and Docker**: `npm run e2e`; `docker compose up --build`.
- **Demo accounts** (when `NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO_MODE=true`): `user@test.com` and `admin@test.com`, password `12345678`. Run `npm run demo:remove` to delete all demo code before building your app.

**Bundle Size**

First-load JavaScript without demo code: 184 KB Brotli for `/`, 225 KB for `/login`, 228 KB for `/dashboard`, including about 112 KB for Next.js and React. CI checks typecheck, lint, Knip, unit tests, build and bundle budgets on every push, and a demo-removal check.

**When to Use**

- **Best for**: multi-role SaaS frontends, admin panels, ERPs, dashboards and multilingual (LTR and RTL) apps on an external API.
- **Not ideal for**: single-page landing sites or apps that need a database inside the Next.js app.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/salmanshahriar/Next-Elite/main/README.md): features, setup, architecture overview, configuration, scripts, Docker and deployment
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/salmanshahriar/Next-Elite/main/AGENTS.md): rules for AI coding agents (tooling, icons, dependencies, bundle budgets)
- [Project standards skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/salmanshahriar/Next-Elite/main/.agents/skills/project-standards/SKILL.md): component catalog, styling rules, server vs client, routing, forms and i18n conventions
- [Environment variables](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/salmanshahriar/Next-Elite/main/.env.example): every supported variable with comments

## Key source files

- [Protected layout](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/salmanshahriar/Next-Elite/main/src/app/%28protected%29/layout.tsx): the single `requireUser()` check and the role-based `@admin` / `@user` slot choice
- [Auth provider](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/salmanshahriar/Next-Elite/main/src/features/auth/hooks/auth-provider.tsx): `useAuth()` hook; lazy-loads the Better Auth client for sign-in, sign-up and sign-out
- [Better Auth server config](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/salmanshahriar/Next-Elite/main/src/features/auth/lib/auth.ts): providers, allowed hosts and role mapping
- [Roles and permissions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/salmanshahriar/Next-Elite/main/src/features/auth/rbac/permissions.ts): `UserRole` union and `ROLE_PERMISSIONS` map
- [Environment schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/salmanshahriar/Next-Elite/main/src/libs/env.ts): T3 Env validation for server and client variables
- [Site config](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/salmanshahriar/Next-Elite/main/src/features/site/site.config.json): app name, SEO metadata, locales, sitemap and manifest settings
- [Design tokens](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/salmanshahriar/Next-Elite/main/src/app/styles/tokens.css): light and dark color, radius and spacing tokens
- [English messages](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/salmanshahriar/Next-Elite/main/messages/en.json): source translation file; other locales mirror its keys
- [Next.js config](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/salmanshahriar/Next-Elite/main/next.config.ts): security headers, standalone output, next-intl and Sentry setup
